summary: Allow managed mining checks to inspect private container-owned chain files
details: On host permission errors, inspect chain identity and recovery markers through a temporary read-only container using the cached release chain image, without starting Geth or exposing nodekey contents.
Preserve database inode, device, dataset and nodekey bindings across stop, recreate, disable and retry, including deep-reorg halt and epoch checks.
Package the standalone probe in the node kit and cover denied reads, identity replacement, missing databases, recovery markers and probe failures.
operator_actions: Use the updated node kit and retry mining check or enable as the normal node operator with Docker access. No database permission change or data rebuild is required.
If CHAIN_DATA_INSPECTION_FAILED is reported, check Docker access and the cached release chain image before retrying.
